D2_random_variable.Y: task success under the frozen Target contract for one candidate rollout
conditioned_on: frozen system dynamics, controller, safety projection, transition protocol and metrics
D2_random_variable.definition: p(x, tau) = P(Y = 1 | x, tau) = E_D[ Y(x, tau, D) ] under the prospectively frozen disturbance distribution
D2_random_variable.why: the disturbance is an explicitly specified probability distribution, so the expectation over it is well defined and is exactly what 'recoverable under disturbance' means

D3_what_the_replica_streams_are.caveat: the probability is defined RELATIVE TO the frozen disturbance law (uniform disk, 0.05*a_max, additive before safety projection). It is not a claim about any real-world disturbance population, and every future report must say so
D3_what_the_replica_streams_are.consequence: P(success) has a legitimate probabilistic interpretation with respect to this frozen distribution
evidence: the contract specifies the counterfactual robot-acceleration process as 'uniform disk, max 0.05*a_max, before safety projection', i.e. a named continuous distribution with a bounded support, not an enumerated scenario list
the draw is refreshed 'every control step, counter-key independent' and keyed by (robot_id, control_step, radius|angle), so each robot and step receives an independent draw
uniform_disk uses r = r_max*sqrt(u_r), theta = 2*pi*u_theta, which is the standard inverse-CDF construction for the uniform measure on a disk
counter_uniform returns the first 64 SHA-256 bits of a canonical payload divided by 2^64, i.e. a counter-based PRF implementing uniform draws on [0,1)

the replica index enters through the stream process label 'robot_acceleration:replica-{i}' and through the matched seed, so replica i and replica j are independent realizations of the same distribution rather than two hand-chosen stress cases
the contract explicitly REJECTED alternatives that would have made this a stress bank or a candidate-specific stream

D8_fixed_bank_versus_population.question: success fraction over a frozen stress bank, or a population probability?
D8_fixed_bank_versus_population.reproducibility_note: determinism comes from the counter PRF, not from a fixed sample list. Re-running replica i reproduces the same draw; drawing replica i+1 yields a fresh independent realization. Both properties hold at once.

matched_randomness_preserved_requirement: any V3 design must keep COMPACT and LINE sharing the same disturbance realization at the same replica index, which is what makes the candidate comparison paired
